{{Engineer infobox}}

'''Wellington Beck''' is an Odyssey Engineer based at '''Beck Facility''' in the [[Jolapa]] system. He is discovered through [[Hero Ferrari]] and specialises in a mixture of suit utility and handheld-weapon modifications.<ref name="inara-beck">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/30/ Wellington Beck — Engineer], Inara.</ref>

Wellington provides [[Extra Backpack Capacity]], [[Greater Range]], [[Improved Battery Capacity]], [[Reduced Tool Battery Consumption]], and [[Scope]].<ref name="inara-beck" />

{{Field note|Odyssey Engineering does '''not''' use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation system used by ship Engineers. Suits and weapons have equipment grades and modification slots, while Wellington installs individual modifications into those slots.}}

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Jolapa]]
* '''Settlement:''' [[Beck Facility]]
* '''Body:''' Jolapa 6 a
* '''Engineer type:''' Odyssey Engineer
* '''Prerequisite Engineer:''' [[Hero Ferrari]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

Beck Facility is a surface Engineer base on '''Jolapa 6 a'''.<ref name="inara-beck-facility">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/275264/ Beck Facility — Station], Inara.</ref>

The facility has a concourse and the services needed to access Wellington's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-beck-facility" />

== How to Discover Wellington Beck ==

Wellington Beck is discovered through [[Hero Ferrari]].<ref name="inara-beck" />

After unlocking Hero, provide her with '''5 [[Settlement Defence Plans]]''' to receive Wellington's referral.<ref name="inara-hero">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/28/ Hero Ferrari — Engineer], Inara.</ref>

[[Settlement Defence Plans]] are Odyssey '''Data''' and can currently be found at:

* [[Irregular Markers]];
* data ports in '''CMD buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.<ref name="inara-sdp">[https://inara.cz/elite/componentitem/10365/ Settlement Defence Plans — Component], Inara.</ref>

{{Important|'''The current referral requirement is 5 Settlement Defence Plans.'''

Older guides may list 15. Frontier reduced Hero Ferrari's requirement to '''5''' in Update 18.08.<ref name="frontier-1808">[https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/elite-dangerous-type-8-update-18-08-wednesday-7th-august.627151/ Elite Dangerous — Type-8 Update 18.08], Frontier Developments.</ref>}}

See [[Hero Ferrari]] for the complete preceding Engineer unlock.

== How to Receive an Invitation ==

There is no separate invitation requirement after receiving Wellington's referral from [[Hero Ferrari]].

Once Wellington has been discovered, complete his bartender-sales requirement to unlock his workshop.<ref name="inara-beck" />

== How to Unlock Wellington Beck ==

Unlock requirements summary:
* Unlock [[Hero Ferrari]].
* Provide Hero with '''5 [[Settlement Defence Plans]]''' to receive Wellington Beck's referral.
* Obtain any combination of [[Cat Media]], [[Classic Entertainment]], and [[Multimedia Entertainment]].
* Sell a combined total of '''15''' qualifying items to bartenders.
{{Important|'''15 is the current total requirement.'''

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Wellington Beck]].

== Obtaining the Entertainment Data ==

All three qualifying unlock items are Odyssey '''Data''', rather than Goods or Assets.

=== Cat Media ===

[[Cat Media]] can currently be obtained from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.<ref name="inara-cat">[https://inara.cz/elite/componentitem/10300/ Cat Media — Component], Inara.</ref>

=== Classic Entertainment ===

[[Classic Entertainment]] can currently be obtained from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.<ref name="inara-classic">[https://inara.cz/elite/componentitem/10290/ Classic Entertainment — Component], Inara.</ref>

=== Multimedia Entertainment ===

[[Multimedia Entertainment]] can currently be obtained from:

* data ports in '''HAB buildings'''; and
* mission rewards.<ref name="inara-multimedia">[https://inara.cz/elite/componentitem/10368/ Multimedia Entertainment — Component], Inara.</ref>

{{Tip|You do not need to farm one particular media type. Keep all three while preparing Wellington's unlock, because any combination counts toward the same 15-item total.}}

Because these are Data items, they do not use the physical Goods inventory carried in the suit backpack.

{{Field note|Current Engineer data notes that station services may not become available immediately after Wellington is unlocked. If his expected services do not appear after completing the bartender-sales requirement, logging out and back in may make them available.<ref name="inara-beck" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering at Wellington Beck ==

Odyssey Engineering works differently from ship Engineering.

Suits and handheld weapons have an equipment grade. Higher equipment grades provide additional modification slots, into which Engineers install individual modifications.

Wellington's modifications do '''not''' progress from Grade 1 through Grade 5.

{{Important|A Grade 5 suit or weapon does not receive a "Grade 5 Wellington Beck modification." The equipment grade determines available modification slots; modifications such as [[Greater Range]] or [[Improved Battery Capacity]] are installed as individual upgrades.}}

See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for suit and weapon grades, modification slots, materials, and Engineering mechanics.

== Available Engineering ==

Wellington currently provides five modification types.<ref name="inara-beck" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Primary effect
|-

| Suit
| Doubles backpack Data, Component, and Item capacity
|-

| Handheld weapon

|-

| Suit
| Increases suit battery energy capacity by 50%
|-

|-

|}

== Extra Backpack Capacity ==

'''Extra Backpack Capacity''' increases all three sections of the suit's carried-material inventory.<ref name="inara-beck" />

The current modification provides:

* '''+100% Data capacity'''
* '''+100% Component capacity'''
* '''+100% Item capacity'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Weapon Inventory]]
* 5 [[Chemical Inventory]]
* 5 [[Digital Designs]]
* 5 [[Epoxy Adhesive]]
* 3 [[Memory Chip]]
* '''750,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Extra Backpack Capacity is one of Wellington's most broadly useful modifications for a [[Maverick Suit]] used for settlement scavenging and Engineering-material collection.

Doubling the suit's carried inventory reduces how often you need to return to a ship, SRV, or station while looting settlements.}}

Other Engineers currently providing Extra Backpack Capacity include:

* [[Domino Green]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]<ref name="inara-beck" />

== Greater Range ==

'''Greater Range''' increases the effective range of a handheld weapon by '''50%'''.<ref name="inara-beck" />

The exact Engineering recipe depends on the weapon manufacturer.

=== Kinematic Armaments weapons ===

The current recipe is:

* 10 [[Ballistics Data]]
* 10 [[Topographical Surveys]]
* 10 [[Metal Coil]]
* 10 [[RDX]]
* 5 [[Weapon Component]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

=== Manticore weapons ===

The current recipe is:

* 10 [[Chemical Formulae]]
* 15 [[Mineral Survey]]
* 10 [[Motor]]
* 10 [[Electromagnet]]
* 5 [[Electrical Fuse]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

=== Takada weapons ===

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Stellar Activity Logs]]
* 8 [[Risk Assessments]]
* 8 [[Micro Transformer]]
* 3 [[Optical Lens]]
* 3 [[Circuit Board]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

Other Engineers currently providing Greater Range include:

* [[Domino Green]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]<ref name="inara-beck" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Greater Range is most valuable on weapons whose normal effective range limits how you use them.

It is useful for outdoor settlement combat and engagements where maintaining distance is preferable to pushing into a weapon's normal falloff range.}}

== Improved Battery Capacity ==

'''Improved Battery Capacity''' increases suit battery capacity by '''50%'''.<ref name="inara-beck" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Reactor Output Review]]
* 8 [[Maintenance Logs]]
* 3 [[Ion Battery]]
* 5 [[Micro Supercapacitor]]
* 5 [[Electrical Wiring]]
* '''750,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

Other Engineers currently providing Improved Battery Capacity include:

* [[Oden Geiger]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]<ref name="inara-beck" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Improved Battery Capacity is one of Wellington's strongest general-purpose suit modifications.

Additional suit energy benefits extended settlement operations, exploration, salvage, infiltration, and other activities where repeated Energy Cell use would otherwise be necessary.}}

It pairs particularly well with energy-intensive suit use and can reduce the frequency with which environmental charging points or Energy Cells are needed.

== Reduced Tool Battery Consumption ==

'''Reduced Tool Battery Consumption''' reduces the suit energy consumed by applicable tool functions.<ref name="inara-beck" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Reactor Output Review]]
* 3 [[Electrical Fuse]]
* 5 [[Micro Transformer]]
* 8 [[Electrical Wiring]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

Other Engineers currently providing Reduced Tool Battery Consumption include:

* [[Domino Green]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]<ref name="inara-beck" />

{{Tip|Reduced Tool Battery Consumption is particularly useful on a [[Maverick Suit]] used heavily for cutting, charging, overloading, and other tool-based settlement activities.

For a suit whose tools see little use, another modification may provide more value from the limited modification slots.}}

== Scope ==

'''Scope''' adds a magnified optic to a compatible handheld weapon or improves its existing sight.<ref name="inara-beck" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Spectral Analysis Data]]
* 3 [[Biometric Data]]
* 5 [[Optical Lens]]
* 3 [[Optical Fibre]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-beck" />

Other Engineers currently providing Scope include:

* [[Oden Geiger]]
* [[Rosa Dayette]]<ref name="inara-beck" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Scope is most useful on a weapon intended for deliberate medium- or longer-range fire.

It pairs naturally with [[Greater Range]] where both modifications suit the weapon's intended role, but spending two modification slots on range-oriented upgrades should be planned before modifying the weapon.}}

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==

Wellington Beck belongs to the [[Hero Ferrari]] branch of the Odyssey Engineer network.

The branch is:

<pre>
Hero Ferrari
└── Wellington Beck
    └── Uma Laszlo
</pre>

Hero refers Commanders to Wellington after receiving '''5 Settlement Defence Plans'''.<ref name="inara-hero" />

Wellington then refers Commanders to [[Uma Laszlo]].<ref name="inara-uma">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/32/ Uma Laszlo — Engineer], Inara.</ref>

== Referring Uma Laszlo ==

After Wellington Beck has been unlocked, provide him with '''5 [[Insight Entertainment Suite|Insight Entertainment Suites]]''' to receive the referral to [[Uma Laszlo]].<ref name="inara-beck" />

[[Insight Entertainment Suite|Insight Entertainment Suites]] are Odyssey '''Goods''', rather than Data.<ref name="inara-insight-suite">[https://inara.cz/elite/componentitem/10294/ Insight Entertainment Suite — Component], Inara.</ref>

Current material data lists them as obtainable from '''settlements'''.<ref name="inara-insight-suite" />

{{Important|Do not confuse Wellington's two entertainment-related requirements:

* '''Unlock Wellington:''' sell a combined total of '''15 Cat Media, Classic Entertainment, and Multimedia Entertainment''' to bartenders.
* '''Discover Uma Laszlo:''' provide '''5 Insight Entertainment Suites''' to Wellington.

The first group consists of Data. Insight Entertainment Suites are Goods.}}

{{Tip|Once Wellington has been unlocked, keep any Insight Entertainment Suites you find until you have the five needed for Uma's referral rather than selling or trading them away.}}

See [[Insight Entertainment Suite]] for acquisition details.

== Increasing Engineer Reputation ==

'''Not applicable to Odyssey Engineers in the same way as ship Engineers.'''

Wellington Beck does not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression found at ship Engineer workshops.

Once he is unlocked, his available modifications can be installed provided that:

* the equipment is compatible;
* the suit or weapon has an unused modification slot; and
* you possess the required Odyssey materials and credits.

The suit or weapon's equipment grade is upgraded separately through [[Pioneer Supplies]].

See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for the complete system.

== Experimental Effects ==

'''Not applicable.'''

Odyssey suit and handheld-weapon Engineering does not use the separate ship-module Experimental Effect system.

Wellington's modifications are themselves the permanent upgrades applied to the equipment.

== Blueprint Pinning ==

'''Not applicable.'''

Odyssey modifications cannot be pinned for [[Remote Engineering]] in the same manner as ship Engineering blueprints.

A compatible suit or weapon must be taken to an Odyssey Engineer who offers the required modification.

{{Field note|Unlocking Wellington therefore does not make Greater Range, Scope, or Improved Battery Capacity remotely available from another station.}}

== Recommended Engineering ==

Wellington has several modifications that are useful across very different equipment roles.

=== Maverick Suit ===

For a suit primarily used for settlement missions, scavenging, and Engineering-material collection:

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' [[Extra Backpack Capacity]] is one of the strongest choices available from Wellington for a general-purpose [[Maverick Suit]].

Doubling carried Data, Component, and Item capacity directly improves settlement-looting efficiency and reduces trips back to storage.}}

[[Improved Battery Capacity]] is also broadly useful, while [[Reduced Tool Battery Consumption]] becomes increasingly valuable on a Maverick build that makes heavy use of the Arc Cutter and Energylink.

=== Artemis Suit ===

For exploration-focused use, [[Improved Battery Capacity]] is generally the most broadly relevant Wellington modification.

Longer battery life can extend operations away from the SRV or ship and reduce dependence on Energy Cells.

Extra Backpack Capacity has less direct value to an Artemis build whose primary purpose is exobiology rather than settlement looting.

=== Weapons ===

For weapons, Wellington's two options are:

* [[Greater Range]]
* [[Scope]]

Both are strongest when the weapon is intentionally configured for longer-distance engagement.

{{Important|Odyssey weapon modification slots are permanent and limited. Decide whether a weapon is actually intended for ranged use before committing both Greater Range and Scope to the same weapon.}}

== What Wellington Cannot Modify ==

Wellington currently provides five modification types:

* '''Extra Backpack Capacity''' — suit
* '''Greater Range''' — weapon
* '''Improved Battery Capacity''' — suit
* '''Reduced Tool Battery Consumption''' — suit
* '''Scope''' — weapon<ref name="inara-beck" />

Other modifications require different Engineers.

Examples include:

* '''Damage Resistance:''' [[Jude Navarro]], [[Uma Laszlo]], or [[Eleanor Bresa]]
* '''Faster Shield Regen:''' [[Kit Fowler]], [[Uma Laszlo]], or [[Eleanor Bresa]]
* '''Improved Jump Assist:''' [[Hero Ferrari]], [[Yarden Bond]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Increased Sprint Duration:''' [[Hero Ferrari]], [[Terra Velasquez]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Noise Suppressor:''' [[Hero Ferrari]], [[Terra Velasquez]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Audio Masking:''' [[Yarden Bond]] or [[Yi Shen]]
* '''Night Vision:''' [[Oden Geiger]] or [[Yi Shen]]
* '''Reload Speed:''' [[Jude Navarro]], [[Uma Laszlo]], or [[Eleanor Bresa]]
* '''Headshot Damage:''' [[Uma Laszlo]] or [[Yi Shen]]<ref name="inara-engineers">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>

See [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]] for the complete Engineer-by-modification matrix.
